A field the save holds, a scoped table's own name, a table the format does not edit and a named column's number take no value, and say why. The base mod still checks, at a file's first delivery, what a shape cannot say: text the save's code page cannot encode, one cell named twice through an old name, and a part at an event this install does not raise.
